items.text: The Biden administration’s unending spending proposals will only add to our near $31 trillion and growing debt. Congress needs to get America’s fiscal house in order, because the Biden administration will never exercise fiscal responsibility. https://t.co/xN7sOmIeZO

Glad to see @WaysandMeansGOP Chair @RepJasonSmith leading the charge to investigate COVID unemployment fraud, a national nightmare which cost taxpayers billions. @HouseGOP will exercise robust oversight of taxpayer funds. https://t.co/YrTtj3NDsL

It is critical that we exercise fiscal discipline in Washington to ensure our nation’s finances are on the right track. I supported the Limit, Save, Grow Act to put our nation on a better fiscal path. Read my full statement. https://t.co/8Rej7br3ek

I want to thank Ruby Jones of Lancaster County for meeting with me to discuss ways to improve federal nutrition assistance programs by providing increased nutritional education, as well her work leading Perish No More Ministries to support individuals struggling with addiction. https://t.co/F6KBQ89tqI

Advancements in medical technology help patients live healthier lives. Federal regulations at times, however, hold back practices which could help folks age at home & receive the care they need. Learn more about my bipartisan Medicare Home Health Accessibility Act: https://t.co/QWAsLtm3Ej

It is important to take steps to protect the mental health of our nation’s children and teenagers. Thanks to Ellie Janson of Lancaster for stopping by my Washington, DC office to discuss the Improving Mental Health and Wellness in Schools Act. https://t.co/nQZoNbXVGP

Constituents have told me about their positive telehealth experiences. PA-11’s health systems offer programs like Hospital at Home, which have positive health outcomes for patients. Listen to my remarks supporting the Preserving Telehealth, Hospital, & Ambulance Access Act: https://t.co/U20mcbXOHd
Joe and Hunter Biden get special treatment, Trump is dragged through a sham trial. Two justice systems. Very sad day for the country and rule of law.
Thank God President Trump is ok. He’s a fighter and Cindy and I pray for his full and speedy recovery. We continue to pray for the health and safety of everyone at the rally. https://t.co/aFwbZVyjCw

Congress must work to ensure Pennsylvania's seniors have a Medicare program that is affordable, sustainable, and provides quality health care. Thank you to UPMC Lititz for hosting me to discuss the importance of a strong Medicare Advantage program to give seniors more choices. https://t.co/fkCPOyabmx

Thanks to the Community Services Group for the opportunity to visit several remarkable programs across Lancaster County. These programs make a significant impact on our community by providing mental health, intellectual, and developmental disability services. https://t.co/wiXSwuMujv
This week I joined WDAC to discuss my visit with the Lancaster County Housing and Redevelopment Authority and protecting Social Security and Medicare for seniors. Listen in! https://t.co/OFq7dfXo28

Our veterans deserve the highest quality care we can provide. Thanks to Aimee Jo Morris for the opportunity to learn more about the ways Glenn Hope Care Farm is supporting the physical and mental health of local veterans and their families. https://t.co/Q2EEume2vc

Congratulations to May Eye Care Center of Hanover on the opening of their new Cherry Tree Surgical Center! It’s plain to see the care that your practice provides for your patients. Best wishes for continued success! https://t.co/BGM5AfeMLd
Thanks to Kara and Dawn, who work with Penn Medicine LGH, for meeting with me to discuss the excellent work they do supporting new mothers in our community. https://t.co/VI6j1A8XxY

1/2 - It was an honor to preside over the People’s House last week during consideration of H.R 1432, the VSO Equal Tax Treatment Act (VETT Act), which amends our tax code to expand how veterans service organizations may receive deductible charitable contributions. https://t.co/w5ucmmGAYm

2/2 - VSOs do incredible work supporting our veterans, an outdated provision of the tax code shouldn’t hinder the work they do. Read more about the VSO Equal Tax Treatment Act: https://t.co/Vtp6gFt7rx

A big thank you to Dr. Mitchell Crawford of WellSpan and his colleagues in the American Society of Addiction Medicine for meeting with me in Washington to discuss federal policies relating to the treatment of patients with addiction. Dr. Crawford also serves as co-chair of Joining Forces, an effort in Lancaster County to bring together organizations and coordinate support for individuals with addiction. I appreciate the efforts of all involved with Joining Forces and the work they do to support our community.

PA-11 is home to companies making incredible innovations, like Guardian CSC, a water treatment and service company headquartered in Hellam Township in York County. Thanks to Mantec and the Guardian CSC team, including founder Bruce Ketrick, and his daughter Melissa, who now runs the company in its second-generation, for a great tour!

If you, or a veteran you know, are having issues navigating VA benefits, getting a VA appointment, or accessing military records, please call my office at (717) 393-0667 or visit https://t.co/lw2jCOUNaI. We will do everything we can to ensure our heroes get the treatment they deserve.

If allowed to proceed, this project would destroy preserved farms, a regional scenic trail, the viewshed of a popular multimodal rail trail, and forested lands needed to help protect the ecological health of this landscape. I'm opposed to this project. https://t.co/Hw2gM1a6vG

Most veterans from PA-11 receive medical care at @VALebanon. Thanks to Executive Director Jeffrey Beiler for showing me their outstanding facilities. The Lebanon VA consistently ranks among the best in the nation for patient experience, and it was plain to see why. I am grateful for all the staff who serve our local veterans with care.

Direct Primary Care (DPC) lowers costs and improves healthcare outcomes. Our bipartisan Primary Care Enhancement Act expands access to DPC for millions of Americans using Health Savings Accounts. Read more: https://t.co/PcNM7WfJV3

While we await additional details, I am grateful for the work of law enforcement officers responding to UPMC Memorial Hospital this morning. Our prayers are with the hospital staff, patients, and anyone impacted.

Jamaal Millsock is a survivor, a father, a coach, volunteer firefighter, and a friend to so many in our community. I first met Jamaal at a local grocery store. We talked about his diagnosis and treatment for stomach cancer and we’ve stayed in touch over the years. It was great to see Jamaal, his fiancée Melissa, and other advocates from Hope for Stomach Cancer in Washington to discuss how Congress can further support cancer research. Thank you for visiting Jamaal, your courage and determination is nothing short of inspiring.
